gloss: to run down; to dash down

definitions.gloss: to run down; to dash down
definitions.explanation: To run quickly downward, such as descending stairs, a hill, or a slope at speed.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{駆|か}け{下|お}りる。
{彼|かれ}は{山道|やまみち}を{駆|か}け{下|お}りてきた。
examples.english: He came running down the mountain path.

examples.japanese: {危|あぶ}ないから{駆|か}け{下|お}りないで。
examples.english: It's dangerous, so don't run down.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{駆|か}ける (to run, to gallop) + {下|お}りる (to go down, to descend)

TRANSITIVITY:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) - takes を for the path being traversed

ALTERNATE FORMS:
Also written as {駆|か}け{降|お}りる using a different kanji for おりる.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {駆|か}け{上|あ}がる: to run up
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}む: to rush in
- {駆|か}け{回|まわ}る: to run around

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {階段|かいだん}を{駆|か}け{下|お}りる: to run down the stairs
- {坂|さか}を{駆|か}け{下|お}りる: to run down a slope
